The living areas open completely onto the garden and covered patio, with a built-in braai. All three bedrooms have their own bathrooms, and the double garage keeps everything as convenient as the setting. Owners buy into Zimbali Coastal Estate, with access to Bushbuck Club, surrounded by coastal forest and walking trails.

description:
A brand-new home in one of the North Coast’s most sought-after lifestyle estates with no transfer duty.

This 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home in The Woods 2 at Elaleni is designed around easy, modern coastal living. The open-plan kitchen, dining and living area opens onto a covered patio and private garden. Owners have access to forest trails, clubhouse facilities, swimming pools, the Leisure Centre, children’s play areas and padel courts.
